A specific globally preheated, optically inhibited DCPD front architecture targets a10cm/1L arbitrary-mask polymer part with10um internal features in~100s. It is a conditional screening calculation and rejected admission, not a prototype, new manufacturing capability or universal resolution impossibility. Existing frontal polymerization, photoinhibition, recuperative microcombustion and xolography are credited baselines. A hot, spatially immobile low-dose inhibition gate remains unacquired.

The supplied reaction-diffusion model rho cp T_t=kappa LaplacianT+rho H alpha_t and alpha_t=A exp(-E/RT)f(alpha)/s uses UNKNOWN effective inhibition s. F(alpha)=integral d alpha/f(alpha) gives an exact exposure reduction within this assumed model. With alpha_initial.05,on.90,off.06, F_on2594.27238,F_off.10362085. At200C the on time~.5109s;100s off holds require s>=2592 at100C,176012 at150C,4900268 at200C. Reducing the shared hot exposure to.5109s lowers s~25036: these are chosen-history requirements, not architecture-independent lower bounds or measured inhibitor properties.

Diffusion attenuates a feature-width a Fourier mode by exp[-pi^2 integralDdt/a^2].90% retention requires integralDdt<=-log(.9)a^2/pi^2;10um/100s requires D<=1.07e-14m^2/s (1um1.07e-16). No TMG diffusivity is assumed; catalyst transport can remain after inhibitor tethering. Thermal diffusivity9.57e-8m^2/s equalizes10um in~1.05ms, so chemistry must retain the hot mask.

One liter~.98kg supplies343kJ reaction heat, preheating25->200C needs274kJ before losses with recovery/startup separately charged. The cited5.4J/cm^2 dose at1.3mm corresponds41.5kJ/L; naively retaining that dose per10um slice at50% inhibited occupancy costs2.7MJ/L before wall-plug losses. This is known-dose architecture arithmetic, not an optical lower bound. An arbitrary10cm cube on10um binary grid has10^12 bits/125GB input, at1um125TB; compact CAD restricts shape families and cannot erase arbitrary-mask input/delivery cost.

The suggested co-immobilized inhibitor/catalyst class has no demonstrated joint kinetics, diffusion, optical dose or mechanical envelope. Source code/results and packaging log are preserved without replay. Reopen with chemically explicit measured/defensible gate parameters and a heat-recovery/pattern geometry outperforming matched existing methods; no physical experiment, priority or energy advantage is established.
